fact: On 14 April 2026 school-district rectors presented OPTIMA, a human-resources application developed by national staff, which had enrolled a significant share of state agents in several ministries.
title: Renforcement du dialogue institutionnel : le Ministre Dr SITACK YOMBATINA BÉNI s'imprègne du fonctionnement des Académies et encourage l'innovation numérique OPTIMA
